Key findings

  • 2.5 of 15.1 acres (16.4%) is buildable at the 15% slope limit; 3.1 acres if 25% slopes are accepted.
  • Largest contiguous building pad: 2.5 acres, roughly 596 x 254 ft, mean slope 1.8%, on parcel 101-B.
  • Constraints removing area: steep 0.7 ac, setback 3.8 ac, flood 12.0 ac, stream buffer 2.9 ac, wetland buffer 3.9 ac.
  • Winter sun on the buildable ground averages 8.5 h of a possible 8.5 h on Dec 21 (terrain shading only; trees not modelled).
  • Winter solar index on buildable ground is 1.0 (1.0 = flat open ground; south slopes exceed 1, north slopes fall below).
  • 70.9% of the property faces south-east to south-west or is flat.
  • 23.6 acres of neighbouring land drains onto the property; about 1870 ft of concentrated flow paths cross it.
  • Zoning: None ().
  • Road frontage: Coventryville Rd 404 ft.
